title: Fernando Mendoza: I'm competing with, not against, Kirk Cousins

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Fernando Mendoza: I'm competing with, not against, Kirk Cousins
sources.description: Fernando Mendoza signed his rookie deal last week and that leaves the quarterback with nothing to focus on other than football when the Raiders open training camp this week.
